lessons_used: Predictions generally overestimate noise-corrected results, though winning tests frequently exceed expectations.
No clear effect was seen for choose_path hints across three tests or choose_path layouts across two tests.
No clear effect was seen for home notifications across two tests.
home wait_info changes mostly showed no clear effect across seven tests, yielding only one winning test.
Evidence remains thin or inconsistent for sign_in copy, sign_in reorder, adoption redesign, adoption new_screen, and finish redesign due to mixed results.
Evidence remains thin for all change kinds with only a single finished test.

candidates.title: Grid layout adoption certificate redesign
candidates.change: Rebuild the adoption certificate step using a grid layout that displays companion artwork side-by-side with certificate attributes.
candidates.why: Adoption step has an 89s median / 1017s mean duration; a balanced visual summary helps users confirm adoption details quickly.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Your companion is ready! Review their certificate details before bringing them to your desktop.

guard.reason: Redesigning adoption certificate layout within onboarding is allowed and preserves screen function.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high drop-off and duration, but previous redesigns showed weak inconsistent lift.

candidates.title: Desktop control guide completion screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated controls guide screen at the end of onboarding explaining hotkeys and tray options to manage the pet.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple emails regarding post-onboarding confusion over controlling, hiding, or summoning the desktop pet.

guard.reason: _order leaves out existing screens ['sign_in']: no step may be removed

candidates.title: Interactive pet style choice cards on story screen
candidates.change: Add interactive style selection choice cards to the story screen preceding path selection.
candidates.why: choose_path drop-off is 76.2% with 514s mean time; early visual style previews provide clearer expectations before path commitment.

guard.reason: Adding preview choice cards to the story screen is an allowed onboarding enhancement.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high choose_path drop-off, but requires flow changes with no prior proven track record.

candidates.title: Reorder sign-in screen after waiting progress screen
candidates.change: Move sign-in step to take place immediately after the waiting screen right before home intro presentation.
candidates.why: 8 support emails report pets missing or reset when signing in prior to completion; signing in after rendering ensures state is saved.

guard.reason: Reordering the sign_in step after waiting is explicitly permitted under onboarding rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Strongly supported by 8 support tickets and funnel, but sign_in reorder tests showed no positive effect.

candidates.title: Existing account pet restoration copy
candidates.change: Update sign-in screen headline and body text to clearly explain that logging in saves current pets and restores previous companions.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets mentioned lost or reset pets after re-authenticating, causing account anxiety.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save & Sync Your Pets
sign_in.body: Logging in connects your new pet companion to your account and restores any existing pets automatically.

guard.reason: Updating sign-in copy to explain pet saving and restoring is allowed and maintains the screen's core job.

candidates.score_note: Very low cost text change with direct support ticket alignment, but sign_in copy tests historically yielded negative lift.

candidates.title: Compact layout for path selection screen
candidates.change: Switch the choose_path screen to a compact layout presenting path options clearly without extensive vertical scrolling.
candidates.why: Mean time on choose_path is long (514s); a compact layout helps users digest choices faster.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Pet Path
choose_path.body: Select whether to pick a classic pet companion or build a custom friend from your photos.

guard.reason: Compact layout preserves the choose_path job of offering both adopt and create paths.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long choose_path duration, but choose_path layout changes showed no clear effect across prior tests.

candidates.title: Animated loading mascot on waiting screen
candidates.change: Add an animated progress asset component to the waiting screen during desktop mascot environment generation.
candidates.why: The waiting step (home) takes median 201s / mean 2336s; visual status indicators keep users informed during background asset loading.

guard.reason: Adding animated progress components to the waiting screen is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Targeted at very long wait duration, but 7 wait_info tests overall yielded minimal average lift.

candidates.title: Card layout for custom pet photo upload
candidates.change: Rebuild the photo upload screen using a structured card layout with photo guidance tips.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failing or rendering unexpectedly due to unguided user photo submissions.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Pet Photo
upload_photos.body: Upload a clear, front-facing photo of your pet for best custom rendering results.

guard.reason: Card layout redesign for the photo upload step is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Addresses customer support reports, but single previous adoption layout change had negative lift.

candidates.title: System tray shortcut hint on home intro
candidates.change: Add a hint box on the home intro screen explaining system tray access to hide or manage desktop pets.
candidates.why: Users reported confusion after onboarding on how to hide or interact with their pet.

home_intro.hint: Tip: Right-click your pet in the system tray to change settings, summon, or temporarily hide your desktop pet.

guard.reason: Adding a hint box to home_intro is permitted as home_intro is part of onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Targets lowest-converting step with simple hint, matching single past test that yielded +5.5% lift.

candidates.title: Split layout redesign for waiting screen
candidates.change: Redesign the waiting screen into a split layout displaying setup status on one side and desktop feature overviews on the other.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes a long mean time (2336s); split layout keeps users engaged while waiting for local rendering.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Companion
waiting.body: We are setting up your pet's desktop engine and loading animation assets.

guard.reason: Split layout redesign for the waiting screen is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Addresses extreme wait times, but major home layout/flow changes historically have neutral or negative results.
